svg.metadata: {"story":"Hannah","act":6,"chapter":"Ch.6 · The Little Robe","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Each year Hannah weaves a little robe and brings it to Samuel at Shiloh as he grows in the Lord's presence.
